If energy-tail risk fades and lagging tightening (housing, financial conditions) bites, the extra 73bp to SR3H7 mean-reverts via lower implied rates (bull-steepener), not via more hikes.
context_build.path_to_current_price: Multi-horizon US rates: 2Y +57bp 1m / +13bp 5d / +9bp 1d to 4.76; 5Y +51bp 1m to 4.86; 10Y +36bp 1m to 5.01. 2s10s flattened 21bp over 1m to 25bp. A 1d +9bp 2Y print on 18 Sep after that priced hike is residual momentum of known news, not a new shock.
